page.title: Introduction
page.help: Dear Users, Welcome to the Earth-Sensor Data Management Plan Catalog! The aim of the Earth-Sensor RDMO catalog is to assist scientists in structured planning, implementation and administration of the data obtained during sensor-based short- and long-term research projects in earth-system sciences. This RDMO catalog was developed as a data management plan tool that provides a convenient way to capture all relevant metadata about a project or campaign, to fetch the instruments and devices used from established sensor management systems, as well as summarizing information about the resulting datasets. You will be guided through these three main parts of the questionnaire. It starts with general information about the project related to your data itself. In the next step, you can provide detailed information about the instruments, or the information is filled automatically if the measurement setup and your sensors are listed in a sensor management system such as O2A REGISTRY or SMS. The last part deals with the resulting data collections. Here you can provide metadata and other details about the datasets relevant for data exchange, archiving and publications (format, size, etc.) as well as accessibility information. The Earth-Sensor data management plan can be exchanged with your project consortium from nationally or internationally affiliated institutions by inviting them to your RDMO project and can be updated during the entire data life cycle. Technical advices for filling the DMP: Please switch to english language in the top panel to ensure correct entries and compatibility with exchange portals. (1) Questions in black font are mandatory. (2) Questions in gray font are optional questions. (3) Information is saved by using the "Proceed" button. (4) It is possible to work through the question catalog sequentially by using the "Proceed" button. (5) It is also possible to process specific parts. To do this, use the navigation bar on the right-hand side. (6) The degree of progress is displayed in the "Progress"-bar on the right-hand side (optional questions do not count). (7) Each question is also provided with corresponding explanatory text and, in some cases, exemplary answers. A tutorial is available here. In case of questions, suggestions or any other issues discovered, please use the Feedback button on the top panel.
